_comment: Project-level MCP server registrations for the homelab repo. Claude Code has no clean declarative user-scope MCP path (`~/.claude.json` is dynamic state mixed with auth tokens), so per-project .mcp.json + enableAllProjectMcpServers in user settings is the most-reproducible pattern. Servers reference Nix-store-pinned binaries from Home Manager packages, so versions follow flake.lock rather than fetching at runtime. Chatlog is restricted to the coding provenance domain here; its Workbench remains the human surface across all domains.
